title: My Cousin's Friend Was Hiding Since Morning #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you're babysitting your little cousin.
He wants to play hide and seek. You count to ten.
You find him under the bed. Easy.
You tell him nobody else is in the house.
He points at the cupboard. "She's been hiding since morning."
You open it. Empty. Just coats.
You turn around to laugh. Your cousin is gone.
*From inside the cupboard, two voices start counting. "One. Two. Three."
The cupboard door closes. From the inside.
Would you open it again, or leave the house? Comment A or B.
